purpose: Local web server configuration and security assessment
scope: The authorized target only, using the plugin groups listed in tools.nikto.tuning.
enforcement: The runner raises an error if a caller passes any excluded tuning character, so the exclusions cannot be re-enabled by configuration alone.
severity_mapping: Taken from an explicit 'Severity: x' marker when Nikto provides one; otherwise matched references are LOW and informational items are INFO.

install.windows: Install Perl (Strawberry Perl) then: cpan Nikto  - or use Docker: docker run --rm -it edtodo/nikto nikto.pl -h http://localhost:3001
install.linux: sudo apt-get install nikto   (or git clone https://github.com/sullo/nikto)
install.generic: Nikto is a Perl program: https://github.com/sullo/nikto
